sn35.57:1.1: kathannu kho bhante, jānato kathaṃ passato āsavā samugghātaṃ gacchantīti? cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu, anattato jānato passato āsavā samugghātaṃ gacchanti. rūpe …pe…
sn35.57:1.2: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ …pe… cakkhusamphassaṃ …pe… yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato āsavā samugghātaṃ gacchanti. evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato āsavā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
